title: In Splunk Enterprise Security versions below 8.7.0, an unauthenticated user could trick an authenticated user into…
description: Splunk Enterprise Security versions below 8.7.0 contain a vulnerability where an unauthenticated attacker can craft a malicious link that tricks an authenticated user into executing attacker-controlled Search Processing Language (SPL) commands. This occurs because the Lookup Editor does not properly validate lookup identifiers from URL parameters before including them in searches. Exploitation requires user interaction via phishing, and the attacker cannot exploit the vulnerability without tricking a user. The vulnerability allows access to data and actions permitted to the authenticated user.
